headline: Congress named a Tallahassee, Florida post office building after D. Edwina Stephens.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 2800 South Adams Street in Tallahassee, Florida, as the D. Edwina Stephens Post Office. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, hours, or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on June 23, 2022, and the naming took effect that day.
